From: Elena Park <elena.park@novum.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo / throughput check

Hi Rishi,

I signed up through the demo flow this morning and selected a Dedicated capacity walkthrough. We're evaluating Redwood for a production feature that will drive inference for our chat product. A couple of high-level constraints so the intro call is productive:

- Peak workload: ~200 requests/sec (RPS) sustained during business hours, spiking to ~800 RPS for short bursts (2–5 minutes).
- Average input length: ~120 tokens; responses average ~160 tokens.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 200ms for short-response endpoints; some non-critical endpoints can tolerate up to 400ms.
- Data residency: US-only is preferred.

Can we schedule a short fitcall to walk through Dedicated capacity sizing and any warmup/kv-cache suggestions? I included my colleague Raul (CC).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering, Novum AI
elena.park@novum.ai

Hi Elena / Raul — Irene from Infra team here; I will join the fitcall if we confirm the 15:15 slot. A couple of quick clarifying questions so we can prepare an accurate pre-size: 

1) Burst pattern — is the 800 RPS spike typical across the day at random times, or concentrated during specific events (e.g., launch windows, periodic reports)?
2) Token distribution — you gave averages; do you have percentiles (P50/P95 token counts) for prompts and completions?
3) Session stickiness — do users tend to send multiple short messages in a session (i.e., repeated KV-cache reuse)? If yes, how many messages/session on average?

If you can paste P50/P95 or a short sample log prior to the call that would be hugely helpful. I'm attaching the "capacity-checksheet.xlsx" we referenced — it lists the fields we use to calculate batch factor and KV efficiency.

Suggested call length: 30 minutes. If you anticipate deep benchmarking or network questions, we can extend to 45.

Thanks — talk soon.
Irene Choi
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
irene_choi@redwood.com
[Attachment: capacity-checksheet.xlsx]
